config.script:
"""
	Authenticate supervisor and execute PAPO signature.
	
	Validates credentials, checks role, validates workstation IP
	for Supervisor_PAPO (Administrator/INTEGRADOR skip IP check),
	then inserts signature record.
	
	Version: 2.0.0
	
	Args:
		self (Component): Reference to AceptButton component
	
	Returns:
		None
	
	Changelog:
		2026-07-06 | William | v1.0.0 - Original version
		2026-07-06 | William | v2.0.0 - Added IP validation by role, best practices
	"""
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger("papo/popup/supervisorAuth")
	
	try:
		# Get input values
		userName = self.view.custom.user
		password = self.view.custom.password
	
		if not userName or not password:
			alerts.showAlert(
				state='warning',
				title='Campos Requeridos',
				message='Ingrese usuario y contrasena',
				btnTextPrimary='Aceptar',
				btnActionPrimary=''
			)
			return
	
		# Authenticate user
		authResult = system.security.validateUser(userName, password)
	
		if not authResult:
			alerts.showAlert(
				state='error',
				title='Error de Autenticacion',
				message='Usuario o contrasena incorrectos',
				btnTextPrimary='Aceptar',
				btnActionPrimary=''
			)
			return
	
		# Get user roles
		userSource = self.session.custom.userSource
		userRoles = []
	
		try:
			userInfo = system.user.getUser(userSource, userName)
			userRoles = list(userInfo.getRoles())
		except Exception as e:
			logger.error("Failed to get roles: " + str(e))
			userRoles = []
	
		# Validate allowed roles
		allowedRoles = {"INTEGRADOR", "Administrator", "Supervisor_PAPO"}
		userRolesUpper = set([r.upper() for r in userRoles])
		allowedRolesUpper = set([r.upper() for r in allowedRoles])
	
		if not (userRolesUpper & allowedRolesUpper):
			alerts.showAlert(
				state='error',
				title='Acceso Denegado',
				message='El usuario ' + str(userName) + ' no cuenta con los permisos para firmar',
				btnTextPrimary='Aceptar',
				btnActionPrimary=''
			)
			return
	
		# Check if authenticated user is IP exempt
		ipExemptRoles = allowedRoles - {"Supervisor_PAPO"}
		isIpExempt = bool(set(userRoles) & ipExemptRoles)
	
		# Validate workstation IP for Supervisor_PAPO only
		if not isIpExempt:
			dbConnection = self.view.params.dbConnection
			workstationId = self.view.params.workstationId
	
			# Get allowed IP from workstation
			ipQuery = """
				SELECT IpAddress FROM workstation WHERE ID = ?
			"""
			ipResult = system.db.runPrepQuery(ipQuery, [workstationId], dbConnection)
			allowedIp = str(ipResult.getValueAt(0, 0)).strip() if ipResult.getRowCount() > 0 else ""
	
			# Get client IP
			def normalizeIp(ip):
				"""Normalize IPv6-mapped addresses to IPv4."""
				if ip and ip.startswith("::ffff:"):
					return ip.split(":")[-1]
				return (ip or "").strip()
	
			sessionId = self.session.props.id
			sessionInfoList = system.perspective.getSessionInfo()
			sessionInfo = next((s for s in sessionInfoList if s.get("id") == sessionId), {})
			clientIp = normalizeIp(sessionInfo.get("clientAddress", ""))
	
			if clientIp != allowedIp:
				alerts.showAlert(
					state='error',
					title='Estacion no valida',
					message='No se encuentra en la estacion de trabajo correspondiente para firmar este formulario',
					btnTextPrimary='Aceptar',
					btnActionPrimary=''
				)
				return
	
		# Get user details
		firstName = ""
		lastName = ""
	
		try:
			firstName = userInfo.get("firstname") or ""
			lastName = userInfo.get("lastname") or ""
		except Exception as e:
			logger.warn("Could not retrieve user name details: " + str(e))
	
		# Build DataAnswer JSON
		dataAnswer = {
			"user": userName,
			"role": userRoles,
			"name": firstName,
			"lastname": lastName
		}
		dataAnswerStr = system.util.jsonEncode(dataAnswer)
	
		# Get form data from popup params
		papoId = self.view.params.papoId
		nodeId = self.view.params.nodeId
		registerCode = self.view.params.registerCode
		workstationNodeId = self.view.params.workstationNodeId
		workstationId = self.view.params.workstationId
		dbConnection = self.view.params.dbConnection
		reference = self.view.params.reference
	
		# Insert signature record
		sql = """
			INSERT INTO registerhistory 
			(Timestamp, DataAnswer, Status, PapoID, RegisterTypeID, [User], 
			 WorkstationNodeID, NodeID, WorkstationID, RegisterCode)
			VALUES (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
		"""
	
		args = [
			dataAnswerStr,
			"Revisado",
			papoId,
			10,
			userName,
			workstationNodeId,
			nodeId,
			workstationId,
			registerCode
		]
	
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(sql, args, dbConnection)
	
		# Show success and close popup
		fullName = (str(firstName) + ' ' + str(lastName)).strip()
		if not fullName:
			fullName = userName
	
		alerts.actionSuccess(
			title='Firma Exitosa',
			message='El formulario ' + str(reference) + ' ha sido firmado correctamente por ' + fullName
		)
	
		system.perspective.closePopup("supervisorAuthPopup")
	
	except Exception as e:
		logger.error("Error in supervisor authentication: " + str(e))
	
		alerts.showAlert(
			state='error',
			title='Error del Sistema',
			message='Ocurrio un error inesperado. Contacte al administrador.',
			btnTextPrimary='Aceptar',
			btnActionPrimary=''
		)
